headline: Bangladesh drafting human-centric national AI policy
summary: The ICT minister announced that the country is working on a framework to ensure artificial intelligence is developed and used responsibly.
details: The ICT minister stated that Bangladesh is currently drafting a national policy for artificial intelligence.
The proposed policy is described as 'human-centric,' focusing on the ethical development and deployment of AI technologies.
This move aims to integrate AI into various sectors of the economy and governance while safeguarding human rights and ethical standards.
The initiative is part of the government's broader strategy to advance the country's digital transformation and technological capabilities.
caption:
Bangladesh is preparing a new national AI policy. It will be 'human-centric' to ensure ethical technology use.

The ICT minister stated that Bangladesh is currently drafting a national policy for artificial intelligence.

The proposed policy is described as 'human-centric,' focusing on the ethical development and deployment of AI technologies.

This move aims to integrate AI into various sectors of the economy and governance while safeguarding human rights and ethical standards.

The initiative is part of the government's broader strategy to advance the country's digital transformation and technological capabilities.

headline: 2 HSC examinees killed in Narsingdi crash
summary: The students were returning from their examination centre in Shibpur when their motorcycle collided head-on with a pickup truck.
details: Two HSC examinees were killed this afternoon when their motorcycle collided head-on with a pickup truck in the Shibpur upazila of Narsingdi.
The deceased have been identified as 22-year-old Nafiz from Hajipur in Narsingdi Sadar upazila, and 19-year-old Swadhin from Baduarchar village.
The accident occurred around 1:45 PM in the Bajnabo Bus Stand area on the Itakhola-Shibpur road.
The victims, students of Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan University College in Shibpur, had just completed their exams at the Shaheed Asad Collegiate Girls' High School and College centre.
Police reported that both students died on the spot. The bodies were recovered and taken to the Shibpur Model Police Station.
OC Md Kohinur Mia stated that the motorcycle and the pickup truck have been seized, and inquest reports have been prepared.
At the request of the families, the bodies will be handed over without autopsy.
caption:
Two HSC examinees killed in a head-on collision while returning from their exam centre in Narsingdi.

Two HSC examinees were killed this afternoon when their motorcycle collided head-on with a pickup truck in the Shibpur upazila of Narsingdi.

The deceased have been identified as 22-year-old Nafiz from Hajipur in Narsingdi Sadar upazila, and 19-year-old Swadhin from Baduarchar village.

The accident occurred around 1:45 PM in the Bajnabo Bus Stand area on the Itakhola-Shibpur road.

The victims, students of Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan University College in Shibpur, had just completed their exams at the Shaheed Asad Collegiate Girls' High School and College centre.

Police reported that both students died on the spot. The bodies were recovered and taken to the Shibpur Model Police Station.

OC Md Kohinur Mia stated that the motorcycle and the pickup truck have been seized, and inquest reports have been prepared.

At the request of the families, the bodies will be handed over without autopsy.
